reason: Provides a vision tool and optional bridge that analyze user-specified or uploaded images with a configured local or OpenAI-compatible VLM and return OCR, layout, semantic, visual, and uncertainty evidence.

summaries.zh: 使用配置的本地或 OpenAI 兼容视觉语言模型分析图片，并返回包含 OCR、版面、语义、视觉信息和不确定项的结构化证据。
summaries.en: Analyzes specified or uploaded images with a configured local or OpenAI-compatible vision-language model and returns structured OCR, layout, semantic, visual, and uncertainty evidence.

capabilities: reads user-specified image files through the workspace filesystem
sends encoded image data to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
parses vision-model responses into structured JSON evidence
optionally processes uploaded image content through a vision bridge
